column_semantics: The schedule has separate columns for Reference Rate and Spread and Interest Rate. For the PIK subordinated debt, the Reference Rate and Spread cell prints the all-in stated rate with an inline PIK component, while the Interest Rate column repeats the same all-in total rate; there are no separate Cash and PIK columns.

rationale: The filing's printed PIK rows use an inline parenthetical, not separate cash and PIK columns and not an additive spread quote. In both cited ZWR rows, the Reference Rate and Spread cell says 14.00% including 10.00% PIK, and the Interest Rate column is 14.00%. That means the stated position-level interest rate is the all-in coupon including PIK.
